title: Best Robotic Arm (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were chosen by counting how many sources mention each product and favoring those cited by multiple sites (Roborock Saros Z70 appears in sources 1 and 2). Other picks come from single‑source listings (sources 3 and 6).
assumptions: No price information is included unless explicitly stated in a source; all other details are taken verbatim from the excerpts.

verdict.pick: Roborock Saros Z70 Robot Vacuum with OmniGrip Mechanical Arm
verdict.line: Buy it if you want a home robot that can vacuum, mop and also pick up small items. It combines strong cleaning performance with a mechanical arm, making daily chores easier. The catch is the arm can struggle with some objects and the setup may be finicky.
